In detail

Everything a visitor comes to Trieste for is in this one rione — piazza Unità d'Italia, the Molo Audace, piazza Oberdan, corso Cavour, San Giusto — and so is the station. Those two facts pull in opposite directions and the rating follows the second. The Prefettura's zone rosse, in force from January 2025, put piazza della Libertà, the station and the streets around it in Zone 2, alongside piazza Verdi, largo Barriera and the Scala dei Giganti. In May 2026 a young Afghan man was stabbed in piazza della Libertà and the response was more patrols and more cameras. Piazza Libertà and the ex-Silos behind it are the end of the Balkan route and have been a standing municipal problem for years. The waterfront and the old town are calm at any hour; the station forecourt after dark is the part to treat differently.
